cards.question:
Frequency counting — hashmap

Count the occurrences of each entry in an array using a hashmap.

Top-k frequencies — hashmap and priority queue

Find the `k` most frequent elements in an array `arr`.

Duplicate detection — set

Determine whether an array contains any duplicate value using a set.

Anagram detection — hashmap

Use a hashmap to determine whether two strings `a` and `b` are anagrams (contain exactly the same characters).

Two sum existence — set

Use a set to determine whether two elements in an array sum to `K`.

Two sum entries — hashmap

Use a hashmap to find indices `i` and `j` such that `arr[i] + arr[j] == K`, or report that no such pair exists.

Longest consecutive sequence — set

Use a set to find the length of the longest sequence of consecutive integer values in an array, regardless of their positions in the array.

E.g. if `arr = [100, 4, 200, 300, 3, 2]` return 3 because `2, 3, 4` are consecutive.

Intersection of two arrays — set

Given two arrays `a` and `b`, use two sets to find the values appearing in both arrays.

Nearby duplicate detection — hashmap

Use a hashmap lookup table to determine whether equal values in array `arr` occur within distance `K` of each other.

First unique element — hashmap

Use a hashmap to find the first element in an array `arr` occurring exactly once.
